test_cases.rationale: Happy path - get all tasks with valid auth token
Missing Authorization header should return 401
Invalid Bearer token should return 401
Empty Authorization header should return 401
Authorization header without Bearer prefix should return 401
Happy path - create task with valid auth and required fields returns 201
Create task without Authorization header should return 401
Create task with invalid token should return 401
Create task with empty title should return 400 - title is required
Create task with missing title field should return 400
Create task with null title should return 400
Create task with empty payload should return 400
Create task with numeric title instead of string should return 400
Create task with minimal title one char and empty description should succeed
Create task with only required title field should succeed
Happy path - get existing task by valid ID with valid auth
Get non-existent task by ID should return 404
Get task by ID without Authorization header should return 401
Get task by ID with invalid token should return 401
Get task with non-numeric string ID should return 400
Get task with negative ID should return 404 or 400
Get task with ID zero should return 404
Happy path - update existing task with valid auth and full payload
Update task without Authorization header should return 401
Update task with invalid token should return 401
Update task with empty title should return 400 - title is required
Update task with missing title should return 400
Update non-existent task should return 404
Update task with non-numeric string ID should return 400
Update task with empty payload should return 400
Update task with invalid boolean type for completed should return 400
Happy path - delete existing task with valid auth should return 204
Delete task without Authorization header should return 401
Delete task with invalid token should return 401
Delete non-existent task should return 404
Delete task with non-numeric string ID should return 400
Delete task with negative ID should return 404
Happy path - login with valid credentials returns 200 and accessToken
Login with invalid password should return 401
Login with invalid username should return 401
Login with both invalid username and password should return 401
Login with empty username should return 400
Login with empty password should return 400
Login with empty payload should return 400
Login with missing password field should return 400
Login with missing username field should return 400
Login with null username should return 400
Login with null password should return 400
Login with numeric username instead of string should return 400
Login with uppercase username should return 401 - credentials are case-sensitive
Create task with whitespace-only title should return 400
Create task with string value for boolean completed field should return 400
Get task with decimal float ID should return 400
Create task without Content-Type header may return 400 or 415
Delete already-deleted task should return 404 - idempotency check
GET /tasks should return empty array when no tasks exist, not null or error
GET /tasks/{id} with max int64 boundary value should return 404 not a server error
PUT /tasks/{id} with null title should return 400 - null is not a valid title
POST /tasks with extremely long title should return 400 to test max length boundary
PUT /tasks/{id} with negative ID should return 404 or 400 - negative IDs are invalid

evaluations.verdict: Valid authenticated GET /tasks returns 200 as expected
evaluations.resoning: The API correctly returned 200 with a valid Bearer token. An empty array is acceptable when no tasks exist.

evaluations.verdict: Missing Authorization header not rejected - security vulnerability
evaluations.resoning: The API returned 200 instead of 401 when no Authorization header was provided. This is a security bug allowing unauthenticated access to protected resources.

evaluations.verdict: Invalid Bearer token not rejected - security vulnerability
evaluations.resoning: The API returned 200 instead of 401 when an invalid token was provided. Token validation is not being enforced, allowing unauthorized access.

evaluations.verdict: Empty Authorization header not rejected - security vulnerability
evaluations.resoning: The API returned 200 instead of 401 for an empty Authorization header. Authentication guard is not properly validating the header value.

evaluations.verdict: Token without Bearer prefix not rejected - security vulnerability
evaluations.resoning: The API returned 200 instead of 401 when the Bearer prefix was missing. The API should strictly validate the Authorization header format.

evaluations.verdict: POST /tasks returns 200 instead of required 201 on task creation
evaluations.resoning: Per requirements, a successful task creation must return 201. Returning 200 is semantically incorrect even though the task was created.

evaluations.verdict: POST /tasks without auth correctly returns 401
evaluations.resoning: The API correctly enforces authentication for POST requests and returns 401 as expected.

evaluations.verdict: POST /tasks with invalid token correctly returns 401
evaluations.resoning: The API correctly rejects an invalid Bearer token for POST requests and returns 401 as expected.

evaluations.verdict: Empty title accepted by API - business rule violation
evaluations.resoning: Per requirements, task title is required and cannot be empty. The API should return 400 but instead accepted the empty title and created the task.

evaluations.verdict: Missing title field causes 500 Internal Server Error instead of 400
evaluations.resoning: The API should validate the missing required title field and return 400, but instead crashes with a 500 error, indicating missing input validation and poor error handling.

evaluations.verdict: Null title causes 500 instead of 400 validation error
evaluations.resoning: The API should validate the null title and return 400, but instead crashes with a 500 Internal Server Error, indicating missing null-check or input validation logic.

evaluations.verdict: Empty payload causes 500 instead of 400 validation error
evaluations.resoning: Missing required fields should trigger a 400 validation response, but the server throws an unhandled exception resulting in 500, indicating a lack of input validation.

evaluations.verdict: Numeric title accepted and coerced to string instead of returning 400
evaluations.resoning: The API silently coerces the numeric title 12345 to the string '12345' and creates the task successfully, bypassing type validation that should reject a non-string title with 400.

evaluations.verdict: Successful task creation returns 200 instead of required 201
evaluations.resoning: Per requirements, creating a task should return 201 on success, but the API returns 200, which is a violation of the specified contract.

evaluations.verdict: Successful task creation returns 200 instead of required 201
evaluations.resoning: The requirements explicitly state that creating a task should return 201, but the API consistently returns 200, indicating a misconfigured response status.

evaluations.verdict: Literal placeholder {id} in URL was not substituted with a real task ID
evaluations.resoning: The test used the literal string '{id}' as the endpoint without substituting an actual task ID, causing a 400 error; however this also reveals the API returns 400 instead of a more descriptive error, and the test setup itself is flawed.

evaluations.verdict: Non-existent task returns 200 with all-null body instead of 404
evaluations.resoning: Fetching task ID 9999999 should return 404 per requirements, but the API returns 200 with a null-filled object, indicating missing not-found handling and a potential data integrity issue.

evaluations.verdict: Unauthenticated request correctly returns 401
evaluations.resoning: The API correctly rejects a request without an Authorization header with a 401 status, matching the expected behavior.

evaluations.verdict: Invalid token correctly returns 401
evaluations.resoning: The API correctly rejects a request with an invalid Bearer token with a 401 status, matching the expected behavior and security requirements.

evaluations.verdict: Non-numeric task ID correctly returns 400
evaluations.resoning: The API correctly rejects a non-numeric string ID with a 400 Bad Request response, matching the expected behavior.

evaluations.verdict: API returns 200 with null fields for negative task ID instead of 404
evaluations.resoning: A negative ID is invalid and should return 404 or 400, but the API returns 200 with a null-filled response body, indicating improper input validation and a data integrity bug.

evaluations.verdict: API returns 200 with null fields for task ID zero instead of 404
evaluations.resoning: ID zero is not a valid task identifier and should return 404, but the API returns 200 with all null values, indicating a failure to handle edge-case IDs correctly.

evaluations.verdict: Valid PUT request for existing task returned 404 instead of 200
evaluations.resoning: A happy-path update of task ID 1 with valid auth and a full payload should return 200, but the API returned 404, suggesting the task does not exist or the update routing is broken.

evaluations.verdict: Unauthenticated PUT correctly returns 401
evaluations.resoning: The API correctly rejects requests without an Authorization header with a 401 status, matching the requirement.

evaluations.verdict: Invalid token correctly returns 401
evaluations.resoning: The API correctly rejects requests with an invalid Bearer token with a 401 status, matching the expected behavior.

evaluations.verdict: Empty title PUT returned 404 instead of 400
evaluations.resoning: Per requirements, an empty title should fail validation and return 400, but the API returned 404, indicating the request was not reaching validation logic or the task was not found first.

evaluations.verdict: Missing title in PUT returned 404 instead of 400
evaluations.resoning: A PUT request missing the required title field should return 400 per business rules, but the API returned 404, indicating validation is not being applied before the resource lookup.

evaluations.verdict: PUT on non-existent task correctly returns 404
evaluations.resoning: The API correctly returns 404 for a PUT request targeting a task ID that does not exist, matching the expected behavior.

evaluations.verdict: Non-numeric string task ID correctly returns 400
evaluations.resoning: The API correctly returns 400 with an appropriate error body when a non-numeric string is used as the task ID, matching the expected behavior.

evaluations.verdict: Empty payload PUT returned 404 instead of 400
evaluations.resoning: An empty payload is missing the required title field and should trigger a 400 validation error, but the API returned 404, indicating validation is bypassed or the resource lookup takes priority over input validation.

evaluations.verdict: Correct 400 returned for invalid boolean type
evaluations.resoning: API correctly rejected the invalid 'completed' field value with a 400 Bad Request response. Behavior matches expectations.

evaluations.verdict: DELETE on existing task returned 404 instead of 204
evaluations.resoning: The API returned 404 for a valid delete request on task ID 1, which should exist. This indicates either the task was not seeded or the endpoint has a bug preventing deletion of existing resources.

evaluations.verdict: Correct 401 returned for missing Authorization header
evaluations.resoning: API correctly rejects unauthenticated delete requests with 401. Matches security requirements.

evaluations.verdict: Correct 401 returned for invalid token
evaluations.resoning: API correctly rejects requests with invalid Bearer tokens with 401. Matches security requirements.

evaluations.verdict: Correct 404 returned for non-existent task
evaluations.resoning: API correctly returns 404 when attempting to delete a task that does not exist. Matches requirements.

evaluations.verdict: Correct 400 returned for non-numeric task ID
evaluations.resoning: API correctly rejects non-numeric ID in path with 400 Bad Request. Behavior is appropriate.

evaluations.verdict: Correct 404 returned for negative task ID
evaluations.resoning: API returns 404 for negative ID which is acceptable since no task with ID -1 can exist. Behavior is reasonable.

evaluations.verdict: Successful login returns 200 with accessToken
evaluations.resoning: API correctly returns 200 and the expected accessToken for valid credentials. Fully matches requirements.

evaluations.verdict: Invalid password accepted with 200 instead of 401
evaluations.resoning: The API returned 200 with an empty accessToken for a wrong password, which is a critical security vulnerability. Requirements mandate 401 for invalid credentials.

evaluations.verdict: Invalid username accepted with 200 instead of 401
evaluations.resoning: The API returned 200 with an empty accessToken for an invalid username, which is a critical security vulnerability. Requirements mandate 401 for invalid credentials.

evaluations.verdict: Invalid credentials accepted with 200 instead of 401
evaluations.resoning: The API returned 200 with an empty accessToken for completely invalid credentials. This is a critical security bug as invalid logins must return 401 per requirements.

evaluations.verdict: Empty username accepted with 200 instead of 400
evaluations.resoning: The API should reject empty username with 400 but instead returns 200 with empty token. Input validation is missing for the username field.

evaluations.verdict: Empty password accepted with 200 instead of 400
evaluations.resoning: The API should reject empty password with 400 but instead returns 200 with empty token. Input validation is missing for the password field.

evaluations.verdict: Empty payload accepted with 200 instead of 400
evaluations.resoning: The API should reject an empty payload with 400 but returns 200. No validation is performed on missing required fields.

evaluations.verdict: Missing password field accepted with 200 instead of 400
evaluations.resoning: The API should reject a payload missing the required password field with 400 but returns 200. Required field validation is absent.

evaluations.verdict: Missing username field accepted with 200 instead of 400
evaluations.resoning: The API should reject a payload missing the required username field with 400 but returns 200. Required field validation is absent.

evaluations.verdict: Null username accepted with 200 instead of 400
evaluations.resoning: The API should reject a null username with 400 but returns 200. Null value handling and input validation is missing.

evaluations.verdict: Null password accepted with 200 instead of 400
evaluations.resoning: The API should reject a null password with 400 but returns 200. Null value handling and input validation is missing.

evaluations.verdict: Numeric username accepted with 200 instead of 400
evaluations.resoning: The API should reject a non-string numeric username with 400 but returns 200. Type validation for input fields is missing.

evaluations.verdict: Case-sensitive mismatch accepted with 200 instead of 401
evaluations.resoning: The API returned 200 for uppercase ADMIN which should fail case-sensitive credential check and return 401. This indicates credentials are not validated correctly.

evaluations.verdict: Whitespace-only title accepted as valid input
evaluations.resoning: The API accepted a whitespace-only title and returned 200 with a task created, but should have returned 400 since the title requirement implies meaningful non-empty content. This is a validation bug.

evaluations.verdict: String value for boolean field silently coerced instead of rejected
evaluations.resoning: The API silently converted the string 'yes' to false for the completed field and returned 200, rather than returning 400 for an invalid type. This indicates missing type validation and could cause data integrity issues.

evaluations.verdict: Decimal float ID correctly rejected with 400
evaluations.resoning: The API correctly returned 400 for a non-integer decimal ID, matching expected behavior and the spec.

evaluations.verdict: Missing Content-Type header not enforced, task created successfully
evaluations.resoning: The API accepted the request without a Content-Type header and returned 200 with a created task, but should have returned 400 or 415 Unsupported Media Type. This indicates lax content negotiation enforcement.

evaluations.verdict: Double-delete correctly returns 404
evaluations.resoning: The API correctly returns 404 when attempting to delete an already-deleted task, confirming proper idempotency handling.

evaluations.verdict: GET /tasks returns empty array correctly
evaluations.resoning: The API correctly returns 200 with an empty array when no tasks exist, matching expected behavior.

evaluations.verdict: Max int64 ID returns 200 with all-null body instead of 404
evaluations.resoning: The API returned 200 with a fully null response object for a non-existent max-boundary ID, which is semantically incorrect and indicates a serious bug where the not-found case is not properly handled, potentially exposing internal data handling issues.

evaluations.verdict: PUT with null title returns 404 instead of 400, likely due to missing task
evaluations.resoning: The 404 suggests the task does not exist rather than that null title validation fired, so the test is inconclusive on validation but the expected 400 was not returned. A separate concern is that null title validation may not be enforced at all if the task existed.

evaluations.verdict: Excessively long title accepted without length validation
evaluations.resoning: The API accepted a 98-character title with no length restriction enforced, returning 200 instead of 400. This indicates missing max-length validation on the title field, which could lead to storage or display issues.

evaluations.verdict: Negative ID for PUT correctly returns 404
evaluations.resoning: The API returned 404 for a negative task ID, which is an acceptable response since no task with a negative ID can exist, matching the expected outcome.
